text: Butler Library is full by 10am during midterms: every seat on the main floors is taken, and students are circling with laptops looking for one (reaction: exasperation). Sidechat posts: "walked every floor of Butler twice, not one chair"; "people leave a jacket on a seat and vanish for four hours"; "Butler at 9:58 is a land rush"; "studying in the stairwell now, this is my life".

The laundry machines in the dorms are all taken on Sunday night, and clean clothes get dumped on top of the dryer by whoever needs it next (reaction: resigned annoyance). Sidechat posts: "came back 2 minutes late and my laundry was on the floor"; "every washer in the building is running at 11pm on a Sunday"; "laundry room is a hostage situation"; "who is doing laundry at 3am and why is it still not free".

Ferris Booth dining hall runs out of the good food by 12:30: the lunch line wraps around and the popular station is empty by the time you reach it (reaction: disappointment). Sidechat posts: "waited 20 minutes at Ferris for the pasta station to be empty"; "Ferris at 12:15 or don't bother"; "they put out one tray of the good chicken and that's it"; "the salad bar is the only thing that survives past 1".

Package center lines at the start of the semester stretch out the door, and it takes 45 minutes to pick up one box (reaction: frustration). Sidechat posts: "45 minutes in the package center line for a phone charger"; "the line is longer than the line for anything else on campus"; "they scan one package every three minutes"; "I could have walked to the store and back in the time this took".

The 1 train is running with delays every morning this week, and students are late to 8:40 classes (reaction: irritation). Sidechat posts: "the 1 train made me late three days in a row"; "signal problems at 96th again"; "left 30 minutes early and still walked in late"; "the 1 is not a train it is a suggestion".

Printing quota: the free print allowance runs out mid-semester, and students are rationing pages before finals (reaction: mild panic). Sidechat posts: "used my whole print quota on one reading packet"; "printing a 60-page PDF at 2 cents a page like it's 1998"; "asked three friends for their leftover quota"; "reading the PDF on my phone to save pages".

Carman elevators: one of the two is out of service again, and the line for the other one goes around the lobby at move-in and at class time (reaction: annoyance). Sidechat posts: "one Carman elevator for 600 people"; "waited for the elevator longer than the ride takes"; "taking the stairs to the 13th floor with a mini fridge"; "the elevator has been broken since I got here".

Columbia Health appointments: the earliest available slot is three weeks out, and students are told to use the walk-in hours that fill up before they open (reaction: frustration). Sidechat posts: "earliest appointment is in three weeks, my cold will be gone"; "walk-in hours were full by 8:05"; "the portal says no availability for every provider"; "went to urgent care instead and paid for it".

The CUID gates: card readers at the campus gates stop working intermittently, and students get stuck at the turnstile while the guard waves them through one by one (reaction: annoyance). Sidechat posts: "tapped my CUID six times at the 116th gate"; "the reader beeps red at everyone and the guard just sighs"; "a line of thirty people waiting to enter their own campus"; "my card works everywhere except the gate".

JJ's Place at 1am: the late-night dining spot has a line out the door after the bars close, and the mozzarella sticks run out (reaction: hungry impatience). Sidechat posts: "JJ's line is longer at 1am than Ferris at noon"; "got to JJ's and they were out of mozz sticks, night ruined"; "the JJ's line is where you see everyone you know"; "waited 25 minutes for a quesadilla".

Lerner ramps: the ramps in Lerner Hall make every trip across the building take three times longer, and students are late to club meetings on the upper floors (reaction: rueful complaint). Sidechat posts: "walked a quarter mile of ramp to go up two floors"; "Lerner was designed by someone who hates elbows"; "the ramps are a treadmill with extra steps"; "took the ramps to a meeting on 5 and missed the first ten minutes".

The waitlist for a popular seminar has not moved a single spot in two weeks, and students on it are deciding whether to keep hoping or enroll in a backup (reaction: anxious uncertainty). Sidechat posts: "number 14 on the waitlist for two weeks, has anyone dropped"; "the professor said the waitlist never moves and then said keep coming"; "attending a class I'm not in like a ghost"; "my backup class already has a paper due".
